newsitem.title: USA: Duckwall-ALCO files for public offering.
newsitem.headline: Duckwall-ALCO files for public offering.

text.p: Duckwall-ALCO Stores Inc said on Monday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1.4 million shares of the company's common stock.
Of the 1.4 million, one million are to be sold by the company and 400,000 by certain shareholders.
The underwriters have the option to purchase an additional 210,000 shares to cover over-allotments.
After the offering, Duckwall said it will have 4,999,885 shares outstanding, exclusive of any shares to cover over-allotments.
